description: About Us Bivha International School Also known as Bivha International School of Health & Science Bivha International School (BIS) is the largest private, co-educational, international school in Asia and is accredited by the Council of International Schools (CIS). Bivha IS has been providing International Curriculum to both the local and the abroad since 2011. With Four locations in India, including a main campus in Bihar and another campuses in the West-Bengal, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh & Karnataka. Bivha IS’ curriculum is based on the Dual certification Program with varying modifications designed to meet the needs of international students. The Dual certification provides a high quality and broad education which enables students to move to any other English-speaking country fully equipped to succeed. It also makes student eligible for both India & abroad. Bivha International School offer classes from Play school to Graduate level, BIS delivers an International Primary Curriculum (IPC) for Years 1 to 6, and students in Years 7 to 13 are taught through a UK based curriculum with an international flavour – preparing them for IGCSE, AS and A Level. It also provide CBSE & ICSE curriculum along with IB & IGCSE. Bivha IS is has a great reputation for academic excellence, placing the success of each student at the centre of our mission. We understand that every student requires more than academic skills to succeed. At BIS, our greatest asset is our students, and as such we create opportunities both inside and outside of the classroom – and with the support of our highly qualified and experienced multi-national teaching staff, we maximise the potential of each child. In total, the school has over 3,000 students representing over 60 nationalities. The school is accredited by the various national & international authorities such as Ignou , Bihar School Examination Board, Bivha Open School Examination Board, Karnataka Open School, Bihar School Examination Board ,Karnataka State Open School, CBSE*,IGCSE**, IB**,Nepal Board of Higher Education Nepal, Bhutan Board of Higher Education Bhutan, Bihar Madarsa Board ,Bihar Sanskrit Board ,UP State Examination Board , Chhattisgarh Open School, Punjab Board of Secondary Education, National Institute of open schooling (Govt. of India). It is the largest open school system in the world. Self instructional material provided by the school, gives the learner an opportunity to complete his formal education at his own pace, time and place. The candidate is fully eligible to pursue his higher studies and participate in various competitive examinations on successful completion of the course. Today over 400+ academicians and professionals around the world work with Bivha IS to counsel and groom over 10,000+ students across 4 locations in India, Middle East and the US. It is world largest boarding school , having 3,000 student passing out each year.

name: Buddha World School
description: About Us Sanskar, Sanskriti aur Shiksha ka Samagam is what Buddha World School, is all about. It has been conceptualized to carry forward the ancient Indian tradition of Ashram’s in the contemporary milieu. Our school is situated in Vaishali, which is one of the most backward districts of the country. Though historically, Vaishali enjoys a special place in the Buddhist and Jain tourism circuit and is also the birth place of Republic, it has remained backward. The standard of education is very poor and the area lacks good schools for the overall development of children. Due to this shortfall, most parents who can afford it, send their children to Patna, Ranchi or Delhi for their schooling. The remaining ones stay in Vaishali without good schooling and learning opportunities. It is these children that our school is catering to by charging basic minimal fees from the villagers. Our school is based on the ancient Ashram system and yet very modern in teaching methodology and school infrastructure. At Buddha World School (BWS) we believe that every child is a divine gift to humanity. Thus we have a moral commitment towards enhancing the capabilities of every child, and provide opportunities for their overall growth and development. Our children are not only getting trained to be self-reliant, a consistent effort is being made to integrate them with their surroundings, whether it is sensitizing them towards the rich cultural heritage of Vaishali or working towards community development through ‘One Good Act A Day’. Our children visit nearby areas and conduct weekly classes through learning buses, they actively conduct cleaning drives to maintain the serenity of Vaishali’s historical and cultural sites among other similar efforts. An amalgamation of traditional and modern, in May 2019 BWS got affiliation from the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) as we continue to experiment with experiential learning methods for the holistic development of children. By developing their life and work skills, our vision is to provide handholding and infrastructure to these village children till the time they become successful professionals enabling them not only to take up best jobs but also become job creators. Being self-funded thus far, and given the humble paying capacity of the parents, it’s a struggle to keep up with our mission to provide quality education, infrastructure and skilling to these village Children. However, under the mentorship of Lt.Col. Bajrang Bihari Singh, founder member of Simultala Avashiya Vidyalaya and continuing guidance and moral support of luminaries such as Prof. Sanjay Sinha, B.R.Ambedkar Bihar University, Muzaffarpur, Shri Durga Pd. Sahu, Ex Teacher, Netarhat Vidyalaya, Shri Mangal Deo Pandey, Ex Principal Netarhat Vidyalaya, Shri Malik Habib Gufran, Ex Principal Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Colonel Keshav Kumar Singh among others, we are striving to make all Buddhites successful professionals and good human beings.

description: About Us Lord Buddha Public School (LBPS) is one of the most prestigious schools in Bihar. Established in 1996 in Aurangabad, it is a private institution managed by the Lord Buddha Educational Development Foundation, Aurangabad. The school is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), the largest educational board in the country. Life at LBPS revolves around a shared commitment to academic excellence, intellectual growth, arts, athletics, ethical awareness, sportsmanship, and community service. The school upholds the founders' vision of excellence in all areas, following its motto: "Service Before Self." School Profile LBPS is a co-educational day-cum-boarding school, catering to approximately 3,000 students. It is located at Buddh Vihar, Aurangabad, near Jasoiya More on G.T. Road. The school boasts a newly constructed, multi-storied grand building spread over 10,000 square meters. The green and serene campus provides an ideal environment for learning. LBPS adheres to CBSE standards, offering world-class facilities, including: Spacious classrooms (20×25 square feet each) Meeting hall and common room Well-stocked library Advanced laboratories (Science and Computer Lab) Dedicated music hall Expansive playground Pure drinking water supply 24x7 power backup with an electric generator At LBPS, education is viewed as a life-long journey with a strong foundation. The goal is to cultivate a love for learning and excellence in students while equipping them with intellectual and practical skills to face future challenges. The mission of LBPS is "to open doors and open minds," preparing students to contribute meaningfully to the nation's future. Our Culture At LBPS, students are encouraged to explore and nurture their talents in an invigorating and competitive atmosphere. The school provides exceptional facilities and guidance from a highly qualified and dedicated faculty. Core values instilled in students include: Confidence and Leadership Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Adaptability and Holistic Growth LBPS emphasizes comprehensive education that fosters well-rounded personalities. The school remains deeply committed to academic excellence while ensuring inclusive education for all students, especially: Gifted students from underprivileged backgrounds Children with high potential facing financial constraints This inclusive approach has placed LBPS at the forefront of education in Bihar. Over the years, the school has continuously evolved with a spirit of innovation, fostering associations and knowledge exchange with top schools across the country and worldwide. Commitment to Excellence All academic programs and activities at LBPS are designed to shape students into individuals of significance—for themselves and for society. The school stays true to its motto:"Be Educated, Be Strong."

name: Balika Vidyapith
description: About Us The great philanthropist duo late Sh. Brajnandan Sharma and Smt. Vidya Devi did establish ‘Balika Vidyapith in 1947 at Lakhisarai, Bihar by inspiration of Mahatma Gandhi under the direction of first President of India Dr. Rajendra Prasad. The couple was close disciples of Mahatma Gandhi and worked extensively for ‘Dakshin Bharat Hindi Prachar Sabha, Madras before moving to establish this residential school exclusively for girls. One of founders, Late Smt. Vidya Devi has been awarded with prestigious ‘Jamnadas Bajaj Award’ for her distinguished services in the field of female education. This school did get the patronage of the illuminories of their times. Names are endless. A few of them are Acharya Vindba Bhave, Kaka Kalelkar, Smt. Mahadevi Verma, Smt. Lakshmi N. Menon, Dr. Sri Krishna Singh, Dr. Anugrah Narayan Singh, Baba Jagjivan Ram, Acharya Hazari Pd. Diwedi etc. Even Swami Nirjanand of Yog Bharti, Munger had been the chief patron of this institute. Today, the trustees of the Vidyapith, prestigious in their own capacity and belonging to different walks of life have left no stone unturned to render their best to help the institution in scaling new height.

It was founded in the year 1982 and is the first school in Patna City to be affiliated to The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examination (I.C.S.E.) New Delhi since August 1999. It is a co-educational Christian Minority institution by reason of religion, established and managed by Jesus and Mary Christian Minority Educational Society, Patna, a society registered under the Societies Registration Act XXI, 1860. The medium of teaching is English in the Institution. In the beginning, the Academy started as a preparatory School but with passage of time and excellence in curricular and co-curricular activities and the growing popular demand from the parents, new classes were added and today it has grown into a full fledged institution imparting education upto Std. XII. The Society was primarily established solely for the educational and cultural development of the people of the area, admits children desirous of receiving education in Jesus and Mary Academy irrespective of religion, caste, creed, sex, language and location.
